dct_description_sm: Beaver Creek is an experimental road site where mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since implementation in summer 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section.  DGPS data were collected in order to determine the road and the adjacent natural ground  geometry specific to each of the 12 experimental sub-sections. This was intended to improve the digital elevation model (DEM) of the experimental site constructed from optical survey data collected in 2008. DGPS data were also acquired in order to identify the 12 sub-sections boundaries and site instrumentation positions.
